feat: complete management account phase 1 (#44)

* feat(auth): add identifier schema

Add the expand-only identifier authority and nullable credential/session metadata while preserving legacy account and session reads. Backfill existing identities idempotently without foreign keys or sequences.

* feat(auth): add login identifiers

Route account creation and login through the identifier authority. Generate tenant aliases with crypto/rand and enforce normalization, tenant suffix, uniqueness, and last-identifier guards.

* feat(auth): scope platform sessions

Persist the authenticated identifier, access scope, and password-change state. Keep legacy sessions global, accept the legacy email login field, and force temporary credentials through password replacement before business access.

* feat(authz): enforce session scope

Load platform session scope from PostgreSQL for every authorization decision. Tenant alias sessions fail closed outside their tenant and workspace projection omits platform and sibling tenant access.

* feat(iam): add tenant administrator

Create one immutable global tenant-administrator role with a fixed tenant-safe permission allowlist. Protect its scope, inheritance, expiry, and last effective administrator across binding and identity changes.

* feat(tenancy): manage tenant accounts

Add server-side member search, filtering, cursor pagination, role assignment, removal, and one-time temporary credentials. Create each tenant and its initial administrator atomically while reusing existing identities and protecting the final administrator.

* feat(api): generate account contracts

* fix(iam): correct account integration queries

* feat(vega): manage tenant accounts

* docs: document management accounts

* fix(snowflake): renew expired ID windows

* chore(api): accept account contract changes
